credentialFields.label: Monarch cookie header (app.monarch.com → DevTools → Network → any graphql request → Request Headers → cookie)

command:
import asyncio, json, sys
from monarch_mcp_server.monarch_auth import login_with_browser_cookies
from monarch_mcp_server.secure_session import secure_session
async def main():
    try:
        fields = json.loads(sys.stdin.read())
    except json.JSONDecodeError:
        sys.exit("malformed credential payload")
    cookie = (fields.get("cookie") or "").replace("\r", "").replace("\n", "").strip()
    if not cookie:
        sys.exit("no cookie provided")
    if "=" not in cookie:
        sys.exit("that does not look like a cookie header")
    mm = await login_with_browser_cookies(cookie)
    accounts = await mm.get_accounts()
    secure_session.save_authenticated_session(mm)
    print(f"ok: {len(accounts.get('accounts', []))} accounts, session saved")
asyncio.run(main())
